meta.parties: Noordeen Et Al. v. Badoordeen Et Al

rules.statement: A fidei commissum was created by the will, with a half share going to Pitchammal's husband and the other half to her relatives in the paternal line.
rules.supporting_quote: "I hold for the reasons given by me that by the last will the testator has given legal effect to his intention that the property in the first instance should devolve on Pitchammal subject to a fidei commissum in favour of her children and that Pitchammal should have no power to alienate the property."
